verdict.rationale: Chroma's own docs have an integrations/frameworks section with a LangChain page for question answering over documents, and an Anthropic MCP integration for agents. However, the LangChain evidence is thin: one use-case phrase and a pointer to a LangChain blog post. Missing for 10: any evidence of LlamaIndex or other RAG framework integrations, detail on the LangChain integration's API and depth, proof the integrations are actively maintained, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can plug the database into RAG and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) through maintained first-class integrations

citations.quote: LangChain + Chroma on the LangChain blog
The Chroma MCP server allows Claude to directly interact with Chroma’s search capabilities through this standardized protocol.
